message.content: Based on the discussion, Gavriel expressed interest in a variety of crafting systems within the game. Specifically, he mentioned that he thinks it would be cool to have a mix of consumables, such as health potions, buffs, or crafting ingredients, which can enrich the gameplay by adding another layer of strategy. He also highlighted the importance of having a diverse range of these items, including potions that boost speed or enhance attack power for a short time. This indicates that Gavriel appreciates crafting systems that offer variety and strategic depth, which can significantly enhance the gameplay experience.
